name: B10-0114/2025 (ESN) – Further deterioration of the political situation in Georgia
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the further deterioration of the political situation in Georgia
part_text:
This text is a motion for a resolution from a political group, not a law. It asks the European Parliament to say that the European Union should stop criticising Georgia's government and stop pressing it over its elections and new laws. It wants the EU to accept the October 2024 election result, deal with the government as it is, and focus on practical cooperation on energy, trade and regional stability instead of political pressure.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. It is a proposed statement of opinion, not a binding decision.
- **Who it affects:** The European Parliament, the EU's foreign policy chief, the Council, the Commission and Georgia's government.
- **What happens next:** Members of the European Parliament would debate and vote on whether to adopt this text.
